match.reason: No single bank point covers the new point's sequence: mod-holocaust covers stages, ghettos and camps but not Kristallnacht, while mod-persecution-minorities covers Kristallnacht but not ghettos or death camps, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Events of the Holocaust
card: Kristallnacht
On 9 and 10 November 1938, Nazi-led mobs attacked Jewish homes, shops and synagogues across Germany and Austria. Many Jewish men were arrested and sent to concentration camps.
Ghettos
After war began in 1939, the Nazis forced Jewish people in occupied Europe into crowded, walled-off areas called ghettos. Hunger, disease and forced labour killed many people there.
Death camps
From 1941, the Nazis built camps designed to murder people, such as Auschwitz-Birkenau. Jewish people were taken there by train from across Europe and killed in large numbers.
About six million Jews were murdered in the Holocaust. The Nazis also murdered many others, including Roma and Sinti people, disabled people and Soviet prisoners of war.
draft.remember: Persecution grew in stages: Kristallnacht, then ghettos, then death camps.

a.q: Which sequence puts these events of the Holocaust in the order they began?
a.why: Kristallnacht was in 1938, ghettos were set up after war began in 1939, and death camps were built from 1941. Placing death camps before ghettos is tempting because they are the best-known part, but they came later.

b.q: A family in occupied Poland in 1940 is forced into a walled-off area where many people die of hunger and disease. What is this area called?
b.why: Ghettos were crowded, walled-off areas where Jewish people were forced to live, and many died from hunger and disease. Death camps were different: they were built to murder people, mostly by transporting them there.
b.clue: Was this a place people were taken to be killed, or a place they were forced to live in?

problems.detail: The clue lists the three dates in order (1938, 1939, then 1941), which the card ties directly to Kristallnacht, ghettos and death camps. A student can work out the sequence from the clue alone without recalling the order.

The why says death camps were 'built to murder people, mostly by transporting them there'. This reads as if transporting people was how they were murdered. It should say that people were transported there, mostly by train, and killed.
